entry.title: Barack Obama składa hołd irlandzkiemu muzykowi Glenowi Hansardowi na letniej playliście 2026

entry.title: Barack Obama pays tribute to Irish musician Glen Hansard in his summer 2026 playlist
entry.content: Barack Obama continues his longstanding tradition of sharing his music (and literature) picks for the summer - and has paid tribute to the Oscar-winning Irish musician Glen Hansard, who tragically died this week in a motorcycle crash at the age of 56.
entry.dc:creator: Culture

entry.title: Miss Supranational: The young pretender challenging the old guards in beauty pageant
entry.content: Held in southern Poland, Miss Supranational is a beauty pageant you may never have heard of -- but it has quietly grown into one of the world's leading competitions, challenging the dominance of Miss Universe and Miss World.

entry.title: Hiszpania: w trakcie pożarów krążą fałszywe teorie o funduszach i farmach słonecznych
entry.content: Sfałszowana pierwsza strona gazety i mylące wpisy o farmach słonecznych to część nieprawdziwych treści krążących w sieci w czasie niszczycielskiego sezonu pożarów w Hiszpanii.

entry.title: Around 25,000 migrants returned to Morocco after mass border crossing into Ceuta
entry.content: Some 25,000 of the roughly 60,000 people who crossed illegally into Ceuta since the early hours of Friday have already been returned to Morocco.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: EU considers emergency meeting as nuclear shutdown leaves Hungary facing energy crisis
entry.content: Hungarian PM Péter Magyar has warned of an energy crisis after record-low Danube water levels forced the shutdown of the Paks nuclear plant, which supplies nearly half the country's power.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Kraj wulkanów i wątpliwości: pełna nadziei i obaw Islandia decyduje, czy rozpocząć negocjacje z UE
entry.content: 29 sierpnia Islandia przeprowadzi referendum w sprawie wznowienia negocjacji z UE, zawieszonych od 2013 r. Udaliśmy się na tę wulkaniczną wyspę, aby poznać obawy, nadzieje, oczekiwania i wątpliwości – i znaleźliśmy głęboko podzielone społeczeństwo.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe (PL)

entry.title: Volcanic land with cold doubts: Iceland decides on EU negotiations amidst hopes and fears
entry.content: On August 29 Iceland is voting by referendum whether or not to resume EU membership negotiations, suspended since 2013. We travelled to the volcanic island to investigate the pros and cons, fears, hopes, expectations and doubts - and discovered a hotly polarised society.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Tylko w Euronews: Parlament Europejski chce przesłuchać szefa FIFA
entry.content: List, do którego dotarł Euronews, ujawnia rosnące zaniepokojenie europosłów planami FIFA. Parlament Europejski chce wezwać Gianniego Infantino na wysłuchanie w sprawie dopuszczenia prywatnych inwestorów do rozgrywek federacji.
entry.dc:creator: News (PL)

entry.title: A history of own goals: Gianni Infantino's timeline of FIFA controversies
entry.content: Europe's national teams have threatened to boycott the FIFA World Cup if Gianni Infantino pushes ahead with his controversial plan to privatise the tournament. Euronews Culture looks back at what brought the world of football under FIFA to breaking point.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Cyprus: 44-year-old accused of spying on British base for Iran
entry.content: The man, a dual British and Azerbaijani national, is being held in Cyprus while extradition proceedings are underway. It is the first British investigation abroad under the National Security Act.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Pozew przeciw Netfliksowi: 105 mln dol. za utracony film „Fortitude” z Cage’em
entry.content: Pozew wskazuje, że zaszyfrowana kopia filmu była na jednym z kilku dysków skradzionych w ubiegłym miesiącu z biur Netflixa w Los Angeles, a kradzież zaszkodziła jego sprzedaży.
entry.dc:creator: Culture (PL)

entry.title: Netflix sued for $105m over stolen Nicolas Cage World War II thriller 'Fortitude'
entry.content: The lawsuit states that an encrypted copy of the film was on one of several hard drives stolen from Netflix offices in Los Angeles last month, and that the theft has compromised the sale of the film.
entry.dc:creator: Culture

entry.title: Is the Ceuta crisis the biggest single illegal border crossing ever into the EU?
entry.content: The massive migrant influx that began on Thursday could be the largest irregular crossing attempt into the EU in such a short period of time.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Houthis vow 'full escalation' as Saudi Arabia launches Red Sea coalition
entry.content: Houthi leader Abdul-Malik al-Houthi warned Saudi Arabia of an all-out response hours before Riyadh announced a new multinational maritime defence coalition, with 14 countries, including Pakistan, Turkey and Egypt, signing a founding statement to protect Red Sea shipping.

entry.title: 'This is our wake-up call': EU crisis chief slams climate deniers after French fires
entry.content: In an exclusive interview with Euronews, the EU's crisis chief said the fires served as a "wake up call for Europe" and insisted that prevention is key to reducing the risk of future wildfires as she called to invest more.

entry.title: Sánchez o kryzysie migracyjnym w Ceucie: „To naruszenie integralności terytorialnej”
entry.content: Premier Hiszpanii Pedro Sánchez zapewnił mieszkańców Ceuty o wsparciu "całej Hiszpanii", za wzrost liczby nielegalnych przekroczeń granicy obwinił mafie przemytnicze i zapowiedział wykorzystanie wszystkich dostępnych środków w celu wzmocnienia bezpieczeństwa miasta.

entry.title: Spanish PM Sánchez: Ceuta migrant crisis 'a violation of territorial integrity'
entry.content: The prime minister slammed the massive influx of migrants crossing over from Morocco as a "violation of Spain's territorial integrity", which he said, "deserves our reproach and our condemnation at the strongest possible level".

entry.title: Ceuta migrant surge reignites Europe's right-wing assault on Spain's migration policy
entry.content: Migrants storming Spain's north African enclave have sparked right-wing attacks on the Sánchez government's mass migrant regularisation. Left-wing forces have derided the attacks as opportunistic propaganda.

entry.content: English Heritage ogłosiło wyjątkowy konkurs dla osób marzących o chwili samotnej ciszy w kultowym kręgu Stonehenge, jednym z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych brytyjskich zabytków.

entry.content: English Heritage has launched a unique competition to satisfy the dreams of people seeking to spend a moment of quiet calm alone within the iconic circle at Stonehenge, one of Britain's most emblematic monuments.

entry.title: How Greece’s ‘door visa’ gives Turkish visitors easier entry to islands in the EU
entry.content: Launched in 2024, the visa-on-arrival scheme covers 12 Greek islands in the Aegean Sea. Nearly 1.5 million Turks visited Greece in 2025, up from 1.2 million the previous year.

entry.title: Prawie 50 tys. migrantów w Ceucie w ciągu doby. Hiszpania mierzy się z bezprecedensowym kryzysem
entry.content: Ceuta mierzy się z największym kryzysem migracyjnym w swojej najnowszej historii. W ciągu zaledwie doby do hiszpańskiej enklawy z Maroka miały przedostać się dziesiątki tysięcy migrantów. Sytuacja wymknęła się spod kontroli, a Europa reaguje na narastające napięcie.

entry.title: Kolumbijczyk wykonał nazistowski gest w Auschwitz. Musi opuścić Polskę
entry.content: 34-letni obywatel Kolumbii, który na terenie byłego niemieckiego obozu Auschwitz-Birkenau wykonał gest nazistowskiego pozdrowienia, zostanie deportowany z Polski. Mężczyzna usłyszał wyrok grzywny, a Straż Graniczna objęła go pięcioletnim zakazem wjazdu do strefy Schengen.

entry.title: Farewell Franco Baresi: Milan mourns an icon, world football loses a legend
entry.content: Franco Baresi, the legendary Milan and Italy captain, who's died aged 66, leaves behind a unique legacy of trophies, titles and a record of defending the club's iconic red and black colours for more than two decades.
